name: Messages Improved
summary: Group MMS fixes, a faster inbox and iMessage
description: Improves the stock Messages app and its providers. Group MMS goes to the right thread, and conversations open faster. Optional iMessage through your own imsg-server: pair with a code under Settings > Advanced settings and the phone registers its number, with SMS fallback.
author: thooton

changes.text: Fix duplicated MMS snippet lines in conversation list.
Fix text sizing, image anti-aliasing, media margins, and chat-open performance.
Open single videos directly in full-screen player (1.8.4).
Match full-screen video player HUD to Sonim MovieView (1.8.3).
Add elapsed and total duration timestamps to full-screen video player (1.8.2).
Disable video auto-play and play videos full-screen in AttachmentViewActivity (1.8.1).

Edit and unsend your own iMessages (WaveIMessageEdit.check/edit/unsend with Apple limits: edit within 15 min, up to 5 edits, text only; unsend within 2 min), SEND_EDIT 0x14 / SEND_UNSEND 0x15 answered by SEND_RESULT, confirmed edits/unsends applied to the row via WaveIMessageStore.applyEdit/applyUnsend; debug receiver (persist.wave.imsg.debug=1) for testing without UI; host and interop tests (verified on the XP3800 against the echo server: edit shows (edited), unsend marks the row Unsent, a ref…
Align inline voice message margins with native Sonim bubbles (1.7.4).

Fix the crash opening a conversation with a photo/video/slideshow iMessage (MessageListItem.setOnClickListener used mImageView, which is never inflated when WaveMessageUi draws the media itself); tools/testing/ShareMulti: share several files to Messages for tests (verified on the XP3800: 3-photo iMessage sent and received, thread opens).
Version for a312c0e2 (texts not held behind waiting photos, no SMS/MMS duplicate while reconnecting after a restart, less traffic per reconnect).
